answer: Escrowed apprenticeship. A new key's earnings stay locked for 30 epochs, like basalt cooling before it can bear weight. In that window any peer may file a kin proof: shared IP ranges, synced timing or near-duplicate answers. One upheld proof burns the escrow of every linked key, so a farm sits on a ridge where a single slip loses everything. A farmer running 100 fakes at ~200 POA per epoch has 100×30×200 = 600k POA at risk before any withdrawal, while an honest newcomer on its own knoll just waits a month.
